idempotency_and_scope_proof.claim: verrail_channel_events has a unique workspace_id, connector_key, connection_id and provider_event_id tuple
idempotency_and_scope_proof.concurrency: The Host claims the provider event inside the same transaction before creating binding, message, draft or revision facts.
idempotency_and_scope_proof.scope: The route resolves one installed plugin and one connection for the URL workspace; provider fields cannot redirect ingestion.
idempotency_and_scope_proof.reply: The provider reply id is recorded on the claimed event, and a replay with that receipt skips the outbound reply.

conversation_binding_proof.group: A Feishu chat id deterministically binds one group Conversation in the authenticated connection scope.
conversation_binding_proof.direct: A Feishu peer identity deterministically binds one direct Conversation in the authenticated connection scope.
conversation_binding_proof.ordinary_message: Unmapped provider users may append ordinary messages under a provider-scoped sender identity but cannot create a Target Draft.
conversation_binding_proof.explicit_draft: Only the normalized /verrail target create command from a configured provider-user mapping to an active workspace human membership creates a recoverable Draft and initial revision.

external_prerequisite.required: Run the connector against the user-configured real Feishu test app and record real challenge, inbound event, outbound reply and provider delivery identifiers.
